title: Cataclysm: Grim Batol
notes: First-party Blizzard overview: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-gb/news/10002188. It summarizes the dwarven civil war, the Bronzebeard victory in Ironforge, the Wildhammer settlement at Grim Batol, the Dark Iron city of Thaurissan, and the later Bronzebeard-Wildhammer response to the Dark Iron assault.
